summary: Learn board oversight, statutory records, and secretarial compliance with practical templates, governance tools, and expert-led exercises.
lede: Board secretarial practice covers the board processes and records that support accountable governance. It is for company secretaries, governance officers, board administrators, and legal or compliance professionals who maintain records and coordinate board and statutory workflows. Participants practice organizing board cycles, maintaining registers and resolution logs, drafting minutes, mapping obligations into compliance calendars, reviewing board papers, and preparing governance reports.
audienceIntro: This course is built for professionals who support boards, maintain statutory records, manage governance documentation, and coordinate corporate compliance under real operational pressure.
prerequisites: Prerequisites: You should have working familiarity with corporate administration, board processes, or compliance support. Prior exposure to meeting minutes, statutory registers, entity filings, or governance reporting is helpful. This course is intermediate, so it suits learners who already support governance tasks and want a stronger framework for company secretarial compliance, board documentation, and statutory control. No coding is required. Participants should bring a laptop for document review, template work, and digital governance exercises.
